.... Petitioners  Versus  1. State of Jharkhand  2. Khusbu Devi, W/o Sonu Kumar @ Sonu Kumar Pandit, D/o -  Dhaneshwar Pandit, R/o -Mohlichumba, P.O. & P.S. -Giridih,
 District -Giridih, At present R/o Village -Surhee, P.O. & P.S. -
 Nawadih, District -Bokaro.
.... Opp. Parties  PRESENT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY  .....

For the Petitioners : Mr. Tarun Kumar No.1, Advocate For the State : Mr. Achinto Sen, Addl. P.P.
For the O.P. No.2 : None .....

By the Court:-
1. Heard the parties.
2. No one turns up on behalf of the opposite party no.2 in-spite of repeated calls.

3. This criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. with a prayer to quash the order taking cognizance dated 04.06.2018, passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat in connection with Complaint Case No. 819 of 2017, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat, whereby and where under the learned Magistrate has found prima facie case for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners drawing attention of this Court to the report submitted by the Mediator appointed by the Jharkhand State Legal Services Authority that the parties have settled their dispute outside the court and have agreed to resume their conjugal life.

It is next submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that since the petitioner no.1 and the opposite party no.2 have resumed their conjugal life and leading a happy conjugal life, hence obviously continuation of this criminal proceeding against the petitioners will amount to abuse of process of law.
Hence, it is submitted that prayer as prayed for in this criminal miscellaneous petition be allowed.
5. The learned Addl. P.P. submits that State has no serious objection in view of the compromise between the parties.

6. Having heard the submissions made at the Bar and after going through the materials available in the record, it is pertinent to mention here that since a compromise has been effected to between the parties upon the matter being referred to mediation by this Court and the parties have resumed conjugal life, so this Court is of the considered view that continuation of this criminal proceeding will amount to abuse of process of law and this is a fit case where the order taking cognizance dated 04.06.2018, passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat in connection with Complaint Case No. 819 of 2017, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat, whereby and where under the learned Magistrate has found prima facie case for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code be quashed and set aside qua the petitioners.

7. Accordingly, the order taking cognizance dated 04.06.2018, passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat in connection with Complaint Case No. 819 of 2017, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate -1st Class, Tenughat,
whereby and where under the learned Magistrate has found prima facie case for the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code is quashed and set aside qua the petitioners.
8. This criminal miscellaneous petition is disposed of accordingly.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) High Court of Jharkhand, Ranchi Dated the 13th August, 2024 AFR/
Sonu-Gunjan/-
